features: Pioneer in innovation and technology for over 35 years. Gives two compatible devices a fast charge at the same time with Dual USB-C PD Wall Charger 40W.
Dual USB-C ports deliver up to 20W of power each, charging an iPhone 12 from 0-50% within 25 mins* and an iPad from 0-50% in 40 mins.
This USB-C Power Delivery certified charger delivers 20W of power from each USB-C port. USB-C PD 3.0 certified, giving your compatible devices a safe and powerful charge.
Universally compatible with the latest USB-C PD enabled smartphones and tablets—including Apple, Google, Samsung, and more—giving you a safe and fast charge for all your devices.
